h10_preread_fallback.note: Uses full committee-visible memory entries (persona_and_committee and institutional, up to 12 items, never persona_private) in pre-read until PANEL-FULL-INTERPRETATIONS-R2-20261114 lands

acceptance_coverage.ac1_six_catalogue_types_and_gate_panels_: services/consultation/meeting_catalogue.json defines MT-1..MT-6 with MT-4 as performance_attribution_review; unsupported/retired types (e.g. post_mortem) are refused with 422 unsupported_meeting_type; existing gate panel tests pass unmodified
acceptance_coverage.ac2_preread_round1_independent_round2_an: services/consultation/meetings.py and services/openclaw-gateway-adapter/consultation_provider.py enforce pre-read of shared case file + committee-visible memory, independent Round 1, Round 2 labelled by role and style only (persona_id stripped/forbidden), and Round 3 only when chair records new_evidence
acceptance_coverage.ac3_chair_synthesis_no_vote_dissent_memo: validate_and_build_synthesis builds sponsored proposals with citations, non-binding confidence tally (voting=false), and dissent_memo_id (MemoType.DISSENT); empty or unreadable synthesis records outcome=REVIEW with proposals=[]
acceptance_coverage.ac4_rosters_agora_advisors_private_serva: validate_and_resolve_roster enforces institutional trading/risk/red-team personas, operational non-private Agora advisors, and private servants only in meetings convened by their owning user or MT-4 reviews whose subject is their own trader; advisors and servants cannot sponsor; positions citing outside case file or own pre-read are rejected
acceptance_coverage.ac5_mt4_attribution_record_red_team_mand: MT-4 attaches attribution_record in case file, assigns luck_or_small_sample_or_confounder to persona-red-team, and accepts only testable causal hypotheses naming component and test (routed as research_demand) or records outcome=no_testable_hypothesis
acceptance_coverage.ac6_budgets_and_insufficient_participant: enforce_meeting_budgets enforces max_participants (5), max_rounds (2 or 3 with chair new_evidence), max_meetings_per_persona_per_week (3 per ISO week), max_calls_per_meeting (16), and cross-persona >=2 trading personas (insufficient_participants), recording refusals in store
acceptance_coverage.ac7_memory_writebacks_deny_all_agents_c1: Writes shared minutes once as institutional fact and each participant's outcome to its own persona memory via /api/memory/writebacks/learn-feedback; private memory never enters a round; participants answer from deny-all consultation agents; C1 read routes return lists, detail (404 if unknown), proposals, and catalogue with schedule and refusals
acceptance_coverage.ac8_integration_tests_and_protocol_doc: services/consultation/tests/test_persona_meetings.py runs MT-1..MT-6 including MT-4 and gate panel through real consultation service, store, workflow_executor, memory service, and adapter HTTP app with model provider doubled at adapter edge; CONSULTATION_SESSION_PROTOCOL.md section 10 documents deliberative meetings
